Track holder by a per-run id captured in the closure. Remove every assumption about callId 1 or 2. Keep the final assertions (sleep called at least once, enter and exit events alternate for the two runs, both promises resolved). Run it 40 times in a row inside the Linux container (docker run --rm -v THISDIR:/w -w /w node:22 sh -c loop, count failures, must be 0 of 40) and 20 times natively. If docker is not available in your sandbox, run 40 times natively with CPU load in parallel (start two extra copies of the test at the same time). ignoreTests reason: only this test file changes.
